title: Swimmers from the Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni Tsunami Youth Swim Team and the Iwakuni City Ocean Swim Team compete during a swim meet
description: Swimmers from the Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni Tsunami Youth Swim Team and the Iwakuni City Ocean Swim Team compete during a swim meet in Iwakuni City, Japan, Oct. 28, 2018. The teams competed at Fitness Club ocean, which contains a 25 meter pool rather than the 50 meter pool the Tsunamis are used to swimming in. By allowing these youth these from different countries to compete it helped build cultural understanding and friendships among one another. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Christian Castro)
keywords: friendship, loyalty, usa, Siwmming, competition, friends, Japan, kids
